description: The Did it work? charity list, filtered: the charities https://diditwork.org/charities/ shows for cause, evaluator (by), measure, follow-up and a word search, in the page's own order. Hide-only: filters never re-order, score or rank, and there are no figures here (each row links to its claims file and API record). Same JSON as https://diditwork.org/charities/index.json for the same filter. Unknown, empty or misspelled values return isError with invalid_filter, the allowed values and a cleaned address, never a guess. Call with no arguments to get the full list and every allowed value with its count. Read-only API, live at https://api.diditwork.org. When count is 0 the answer carries coverage: what we don't cover (for example climate, or a charity the evaluators we follow don't rate) and what to do instead; never a guessed rating. When the words name a well-known charity that is not on our list, or a cause or topic we don't rate, a non-empty answer carries partial_coverage saying so.

cause.description: A cause slug; call with no arguments to see parameters.cause with counts.

followup.description: true: only charities with a follow-up record in the outcome ledger.

q.description: Words that must all appear in the name, description, designation, cause names or everyday words for those causes; case and accents ignored. No leading or trailing spaces.
